comparison.objective: Use a detacher to release and withdraw an anti-theft pin from a jacket cuff; candidate separates finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Precisely seat a detacher while coordinating pin extraction against a physical latch versus pouring, two-arm screen control, and agitation that induces end-first media passage.
comparison.success_condition: Credit depends on detacher seating and 5–15 mm pin travel while seated, ending with the pin out and hands 30 mm clear for 1 s. Candidate requires complete loading, ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no spill/contamination/damage, and supported release for 3 s. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Latch release under simultaneous tool placement and extraction does not test granular screening.
